spans.s:
(ङ) त्रैङ 1st cl. (त्रायते)
To preserve, to protect, to cherish, to defend, &c.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Giving three times, relating to thrice, three qualities, &c.
E.
त्रिगुण, and ठक् aff.

n. (-ण्यं)
1 The quality of three Guṇas or properties collectively.
2 A trine, a multiplication by three.
E.
त्रिगुण, and यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Sacred to the gods, belonging or relating to them.
E.
त्रिदश, and ठञ् aff.

ind.
In three ways, three-fold.
E.
त्रि three, धमञ् affix; also ड being added, the word becomes an attributive, and may be inflected in the three genders, त्रैध, mfn. (-धः-धी-धं).

m. (-रः)
Tripura or Tipperah: see त्रिपुर.
E.
अण् added to त्रिपुर.

mf. (-कः-का)
(In Arithmetic,) The rule of three: it is of two kinds क्रमत्रैराशिकः Rule of three direct, व्यस्त or विलोमत्रैराशिक Rule of three inverse.
E.
त्रि three, राशि quantity, ठञ् aff.

n. (-प्यं)
Three ways or forms.
E.
त्रि, रूप form, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-क्यं)
The three worlds, or heaven, hell, and earth.
E.
वि लोक, and ष्यञ् aff.

f. (-या)
A sort of hemp from which an intoxicating infusion, &c. is prepared.
E.
त्रैलोक्य, and विजाय subduing; alluding to its inebriating properties.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating to the three objects of life.
E.
त्रिवर्ग, and ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Relating or belonging to three castes, the first three.
E.
त्रि, वर्ण cast, ठक् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Triennial, three years old, &c.
E.
त्रिवष three years, ठञ् aff.

m. (-ट्यः)
A scholar in the three Vedas, or one who possesses three sciences^1.
n. (-द्यं)
A collection or assembly of learned Brahmans.
E.
त्रि three, विद्या knowledge, and अण् aff.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

n. (-ध्यं)
Three ways or kinds.
E.
त्रिविध, and यञ् aff.

mfn. (-कः-की-कं)
Scriptural, enjoined by the Vedas.
E.
त्रिवेद, and यक् aff.

mfn. (-भः-भी-भं)
Relating to or written in the Triṣṭubh metre.
E.
त्रिष्टुभ्, and अण् aff.

n. (-र्य्यं)
The three accents collectively.
E.
त्रि, and स्वर vowel sound, ष्यञ् aff.

n. (-णं)
A period or age of three years.
E.
त्रिहायण, and उ, अण् affix; also read त्रैहायन.
